name: Eli T. Enger
tagline: Top rated Employment & Labor attorney in Mesa, Arizona
education: The University of Arizona James E. Rogers College of Law
about: A partner at Udall Shumway PLC, situated in Mesa, Arizona, Eli T. Enger has been licensed to practice law since 2016 and in Arizona since 2018. Over the years, he has honed his skills and built up the acumen required to handle a variety of law fields, including:

An alumnus of Washington State University, Mr. Enger graduated with his Bachelor of Arts degree in 2012. He enrolled in the University of Arizona – James E. Rogers College of Law to complete his Juris Doctor in 2015. Taking the initial step into the professional field of law, he commenced his clerkship with the United States Bankruptcy Court for the District of Arizona, where he garnered experience in commercial and bankruptcy cases and gained insights into the relevant procedures.

Mr. Enger is admitted to practice before the Arizona Supreme Court, the U.S. District Court for the District of Arizona, the Washington Supreme Court and the U.S. District Courts for the Eastern and Western Districts of Washington. Joining private practice, he was driven by his passion to help people who sought legal help and assistance. He has also lent his services to a college in the Pacific Northwest, where he worked as an assistant general counsel handling matters of education law, labor and employment law, and constitutional law.

In addition to his routine practice, Mr. Enger extends his service to the people of his community. He sets aside time to work as a part of various organizations such as the Big Brothers Big Sisters of America.
Eli T. Enger is a debt relief agent. He helps people file for bankruptcy relief under the Bankruptcy Code.
